summary: End-to-end testing of NutriVerse complete. Backend: 28/28 pytest passed (auth, recipes, TDEE, nutrition, meal plan, AI smart-plan free+premium, AI coach, lifestyle). Frontend: all critical flows verified — landing, register, 3-step onboarding, home (4 category tiles, Today snapshot, Storymap CTA, bottom nav), Explore (with Chef tab), Recipe detail (ingredient images + YouTube video player + nutrition label + log-meal), Meal Plan (AI smart-plan with paywall + ₹300 premium unlock), Profile (Lifestyle Engine on premium, Coach FAB, theme toggle). All 31 recipes seeded; ?country=India&region=South India returns exactly Idli Sambar + Masala Dosa. TDEE for male/28/75kg/178cm/active = BMR 1729, TDEE 2982 (matches spec).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 620 lines — consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/recipes.py, routers/ai.py, routers/lifestyle.py for maintainability
Unused helper _llm_chat() in server.py (never called) — dead code
AI smart-plan rule-based fallback returns only 6 recipe ids cycled → weekly_plan items < 21 when AI fails; consider expanding fallback pool to 7+ ids
JWT_SECRET defaults to 'nutriverse-dev' if env missing — should fail-fast in production via os.environ['JWT_SECRET']
Bottom nav uses testid prefix 'bnav-*' — review request mentioned 'nav-*'; minor naming inconsistency but not a defect
test_credentials: No pre-seeded users. Tests register fresh accounts using @nutri.example.com (real TLD required since EmailStr rejects .test). Premium toggled via POST /api/user/upgrade.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient users with 'TEST_'/'test_'/'prem_'/'reg_'/'up_'/'e2e_' email prefixes — not cleaned up but isolated by uuid; safe for repeated runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 28 endpoints with create→GET persistence checks. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. EmailStr rejects .test/.local TLDs — use @example.com domains. Claude Sonnet 4.5 calls take 5-30s; smart-plan has rule-based fallback so test should not fail even if AI key is rate-limited. Bottom nav testids are 'bnav-home', 'bnav-explore', 'bnav-mealplan', 'bnav-track', 'bnav-profile'.
